relationships.subject: artemin
relationships.evidence_quote: cold sensitization induced by endogenous inflammatory mediators and proalgesic neuropeptides is mediated exclusively by artemin acting on its receptor GFRα3

key_findings: Intraplantar 4HNE, LPA, CGRP and substance P cause TRPM8- and GFRα3-dependent cold allodynia; anti-artemin reverses it.
CGRP mediates cold allodynia in females and TLR4 in males.
